demo.code:
You: save for me
Agent: I'll put 10% of every buy, sell and send into savings only you can withdraw, from a $10 budget. One-time setup, under a cent. Sound good?
You: yes
You: (you trade normally, STAQ is silent)
You: How much have I STAQ'd?
Agent: You've saved $18.43: $15.10 earning in a Morpho vault, $3.33 waiting to go in.
You: Claim my STAQ
Agent: (your own wallet signs the withdrawal, the reserve pays only its owner, so it can only ever come back to you)

setup: Say: save for me (10% of every buy, sell and send is the default)
Say yes once: a one-time setup under a cent, and a savings budget ($10 by default) your agent saves from
Trade normally, STAQ saves silently into a reserve only you can withdraw from
Ask How much have I STAQ'd? any time, and Claim my STAQ when you want it back
